mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds regardless of the absolute level of the rate, as long as it remains at or near the zero lower bound.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows strong positive correlation between low FEDFUNDS and SPX returns in post-2008 period
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (indicating strengthening labor market conditions) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2011 Q3 unemployment rate decline from 9.5% to 9.1%
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances (UNRATE decline >0.5pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive equity returns. The interaction effect is significant: the combined signal is stronger than the individual series alone.
evidence_refs: fact:2011 Q3 HOUST at 604k and RSAFS at $389.5B
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with positive interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230, it signals a high inflation regime that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
evidence_refs: fact:2011 Q3 CPI index at 226.268, below 230 threshold
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with PAYEMS growth > 50k.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2011 Q3 INDPRO at 94.0419, down from 95.0 in Q2
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (INDPRO decline >1.0pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in consumer inflation signals a 'hawkish' monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days. The interaction effect is non-additive: the combined signal is stronger than the individual effects.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with the interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 90), a decline in industrial production signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2011 Q3 INDPRO at 94.0419, above 90 threshold
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 90.
